decisions.statement: An edge is read off the `parts` of the domain holding it rather than off the domain held.
A slug carrying no domain page refuses the call by name.
A domain held by several domains is drawn beneath each of them.
A domain already open further up its own branch is drawn once and marked.
A page of the `domain` page type alone is read where `--descent` is not said.
The pages are read from the index, which applies nothing of its own to what a page declares.
A flag `domain dag` does not take is refused by name.
A flag wanting a word and handed no word is refused.
A tree with nothing refuses rather than answering empty.

definition: the command drawing the domain tree, each domain under the domain with it
